label: Quy tắc quyết định kỹ thuật, không phải ý nghĩa thống kê
scope: P5 technique acceptance; documentation contract, P5 runtime integration pending

comparison.control: currently accepted configuration, frozen before each experiment
comparison.changes: one declared technique or a declared simplification
comparison.model_bakeoff: separate protocol required; changing model is not a same-model technique comparison

unit.warning: Net score points are not a count of changed questions; wrong-to-correct contributes +2.

global_gate.simplification_requires: documented removal or reduction of system complexity; not a new technique relabeled as simplification

cluster_gates.membership: frozen leakage components in the existing split lock; no repartition
cluster_gates.nondecrease_rule: at least 3 of 4 components have net_points >= -1

runtime_gate.rule: candidate remains within the measured P3 runtime budget including load/IO and declared workload; reject if exceeded even when PA improves
runtime_gate.p3_measurements: pending P3; cannot claim this gate from P1 smoke latency

uncertainty.business_bootstrap: report only; correlated businesses do not establish independent sample size
uncertainty.leakage_component_bootstrap: report only; four components are too few for the project's significance claim policy
uncertainty.label: Mô tả, không phải cổng
uncertainty.legacy_bootstrap_internal_decision: diagnostic only; must not decide G5 acceptance

selection_controls.dev: all per-technique development/comparison; repeated selection may still overfit dev
selection_controls.calibration: P6 thresholds and final configuration check only; no per-technique P5 selection or per-question debugging
selection_controls.holdout: one frozen evaluation at P7 under existing access/release policy

report: global net points and delta PA
per-component N/net points/delta PA and gates
